verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is an agent skill pack tied to the YYLO CLI and Ledger, which store user records, so a training-data opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack contains no mention of training-data use, opt-out controls, or any data-usage policy. The isolated configuration directory in docs-2 is for validating checkouts, not a privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
